blocks.text: Fig. 15.14 mein lens ki convex (bahar ko ubhri hui) satah aik hamwar (plane) sheeshe ki plate ko chhoo rahi hai. Dono satahon ke darmiyan hawa ki patli film ban jati hai. Is intizam ko monochromatic (aik rang ki) roshni mein dekhein to gol (circular) interference fringes nazar aate hain (Fig. 15.15). Newton ne inhein parha tha, is liye inhein Newton's rings kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Plano-convex lens, seedhi satah oopar, hamwar sheeshe ki plate par rakha aur markaz par chhoota hua. Kinare ke qareeb aik shua neeche aati hai aur motai t wali hawa ki patli tah ke oopar aur neeche se mun'akis do shuaein aankh tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.14: Sheeshe ki plate se chhoota convex lens (kitab ki Figure 15.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Gol manzar jis mein hum-markaz andhere aur roshan halqe hain aur markaz par andhera nuqta; markaz se door halqe qareeb qareeb hote jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.15: Gol interference fringes (kitab ki tasveer Figure 15.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Markaz par lens aur plate chhoote hain, is liye wahan hawa ki motai sifar hai; phir bhi markaz andhera hai kyunke neeche wali satah se mun'akis lehar aadhe chakkar (half cycle) ka phase badal leti hai. Bahar ki taraf hawa ki tah tezi se moti hoti hai, is liye halqe qareeb qareeb aate hain.

Newton's rings tab bante hain jab plano-convex lens (aik taraf seedha, doosri taraf ubhra hua lens) hamwar sheeshe ki plate par rakha jaye aur dono ke darmiyan hawa ki patli film ban jaye. Monochromatic source (jaise sodium lamp) ki roshni is hawa ki film ki oopar aur neeche dono satahon se reflect hoti hai. Reflected shuaein, apne path difference aur phase shift ke mutabiq, constructive interference (roshan rings) ya destructive interference (andhere rings) karti hain. Newton's rings se monochromatic roshni ki wavelength nikali ja sakti hai, lens ka radius of curvature (golai ka radius) maloom kiya ja sakta hai, aur precision optics (bareek optical kaam) mein satah ki kharabiyan (irregularities) pakri jati hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Lens ke markaz se barabar faasle par hawa ki film ki motai barabar hoti hai, is liye fringes daire (rings) ki shakal mein bante hain.

blocks.prompt: Newton's rings ka markazi point andhera kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Contact ke point par hawa ki film ki motai taqreeban sifar hai, is liye path difference nahi; lekin sheeshe ki plate se (hawa se sheeshe par) reflect hone wali lehar aadhe cycle ka phase shift leti hai. Is liye dono reflected lehrein aadha cycle out of phase ho kar aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain.

items: Newton's rings: plano-convex lens aur hamwar plate ke darmiyan hawa ki film se gol fringes.
Roshan rings constructive, andhere rings destructive interference; path difference aur phase shift par munhasir.
Istemal: wavelength, lens ka radius of curvature, satah ki kharabiyan.
